items.title: Quad Race
items.creator: RareLoot
items.description:
Are you ready for an epic quad race?

- for 1-6 players

- by Enigma Creations

items.title: Halloween Mansion
items.creator: RareLoot
items.description:
Will you find all the items and make it out alive?

- Custom model, items and textures
- by Eternal Creations

items.title: Billionaires
items.creator: RareLoot
items.description:
Are you ready to explore this huge mansion? Here you will find awesome vehicles and can live the dream.
Experience life as a billionaire!

- Unique vehicles
- Fully furnished mansion
- Perfect for roleplay with friends!
- By RareLoot

items.title: Temple Island
items.creator: Shaliquinn's Schematics
items.description: Journey to a long forgotten destination with the newest release from Shaliquinn's Schematics! Myths and urban legends alike whisper of an island, far over the horizon, lost long ago to the ravages of time and creatures that inhabit its shores. No other explorer has braved its dangers in some time, but you are no ordinary adventurer...

items.title: Millionaire Super Mansion
items.creator: 4KS Studios
items.description: Millionaire Super Mansion is a luxurious survival destination! Survive in a giant furnished mansion on the snowy hills!

items.title: Oasis Tree House
items.creator: Gearblocks
items.description: Explore this great oasis searching the giant tree house where you will find all the treasures you want!

items.title: Rainy Day Teens
items.creator: Hourglass Studios
items.description:
Hold hands with your favorite teen couples out in the Minecraft rain! These fashionable teens come with the cutest raincoats for those boring rainy days! With these pastel colors you and your friends will be ready to play all day!

- Raincoat and rain boots outfits!
- 8 rainy day teens!
- 4 couples!
- By: Hourglass Studios

items.title: Candy Castle
items.creator: Odyssey Builds
items.description:
Enter a castle made out of candy! Race your friends using the candy cars and motorbikes - or take to the skies in a delicious plane!

+ Includes furniture models
+ 4 sweet skins
+ 1 FREE skin
+ Great for roleplay

items.title: TOP 10 V3
items.creator: CanadaWebDeveloper
items.description:
Looking for a fresh style? These skins will blow you away! Here is the third release of Top 10 for Minecraft! For all gamers.

10 HD (128px) skins including:


- 9 trending outfits
- 1 exclusive free skin by: Dannny0117

Created and Published by: Dannny0117 + Canada Web Developer.

items.title: Mob Trick-Or-Treat
items.creator: BLOCKLAB Studios
items.description:
Mobs need candy, too! Dress up as your favorite mob… dressed as THEIR favorite mob!

- 12 HD skins
- 6 mobs in costumes
- 6 teens ready for trick-or-treating 
- Licensed by The Pocalypse Studios and published by BLOCKLAB Studios.

items.title: Animals Expansion
items.creator: Cubed Creations
items.description:
Done with waiting for more animals to be added to Minecraft? Well, this amazing world has many new animals! You can tame, breed, play and ride on them! Be careful! Some animals don't like it when you get to close to them! Ready to play and take care of these cute and sweet creatures?

+Giant treehouse!
+Lots of new mobs!
+New underwater, ice, savannah, jungle & swamp mobs!

items.title: Jolicraft's Zombos HD
items.creator: Jolicraft
items.description:
Zombies are especially frightening when the sun sets. During the day they're just a bunch of slow brainless dolts. But at night, they change. They become fast, viscous, and... HUNGRY!!
+ Now YOU can be the zombies!
+ Brains not included
+ 12 creepy zombie skins to choose from
+ Goes great with JOLICRAFT HD texture pack!

items.title: Mob Skyblock
items.creator: Mine-North
items.description:
Explore the unique take on the popular Skyblock game. Mob Skyblock. Now with your favorite Minecraft Mobs. From Steve, to a Creeper, to a Blaze and even the Ender Dragon.

+ 18 Mob Islands
+ Skyblock
+ Multiplayer
+ Nether & End

items.title: Influencer Mansion
items.creator: Mine-North
items.description:
Celebrate amazing influencer parties and role-play in your big modern mansion with many influencers and furniture. Don't forget to drive the car and take pictures in the photo booth!

+ Modern Mansion
+ A lot of Furniture and Cars
+ 40 guys and girls
+ With many Skins

Created by Mine-North

items.title: Castle Island
items.creator: Mine-North
items.description:
Explore the castle island and create your own adventures! Play as prince or pirate and be prepared for danger! Start from your castle and visit the island! Can you find the hidden treasure?

+ Epic island
+ Your own castle
+ Sailing boat craftable
+ An epic treasure
+ 2 insane skins

Buy now and begin your adventure!

items.title: Zombie Apocalypse Parkour
items.creator: BLOCKLAB Studios
items.description:
Oh gosh! No! Our camp is being attacked by zombies! We must hurry and prepare to escape from the zombie horde and run through various obstacles to reach a new place.

- 34 different levels
- Easy parkour everyone can enjoy
- Multiplayer friendly
- Convenient checkpoints
- Awesome aesthetics and atmosphere
- Licensed by Overtales Studio and published by BLOCKLAB Studios.

items.title: Haunted Halloween
items.creator: BLOCKLAB Studios
items.description:
Halloween is here! Boo-hoo-hoo! Be the spookiest and scare your friends with the most unique costume. You can be whoever you want: a zombie, a skeleton, or a ghost. Put on the mask and start the party!

- 21 spooky skins
- 1 free skin
- Licensed by Dragon Blocks and published by BLOCKLAB Studios.

items.title: Halloween Costumes
items.creator: BLOCKLAB Studios
items.description:
Halloween is here! Are you ready to go trick or treating? Grab your favorite costume to scare your friends into this spooky holiday party.

- 12 awesome skins
- Perfect for roleplay
- Published by BLOCKLAB Studios under license from Overtales Studio.

items.title: Monsters In Pyjamas
items.creator: BLOCKLAB Studios
items.description:
It's the Halloween season! Scare the living daylights out of your friends with these spooky, scary monster skins! Roleplay as your favorite horrifying creature: a zombie, a vampire, or perhaps a mummy?

- 12 spooky Halloween skins!
- Published by BLOCKLAB Studios under license from Lothiredon.

items.title: Mega Halloween 2021
items.creator: BLOCKLAB Studios
items.description:
The spooky season is here! Dark and terrifying monsters have arrived along with it! Ghosts, vampires, pumpkins, or scary teen outfits are all to choose from. There are 13 gloomy skins to use for this Halloween, be the scariest monster out there!

- 13 AWESOME HALLOWEEN skins
- Published by BLOCKLAB Studios under license from UniDesigns.

items.title: Craftable: Mob Houses
items.creator: 57Digital
items.description:
Have you ever wanted to live in your very own creeper, cow, or bright pink sheep house?! Well, now you can in Craftable: Mob Houses. 

- Includes 10 craftable houses (including creeper, zombie, pig, cow, sheep, villager, bee, spider, strider, and enderman!)
- Easy to use Craftidex to browse the recipes
- Nudge, rotate and undo support
- 10 skins included
- By 57Digital

items.title: Halloween One Block
items.creator: Fall Studios
items.description:
Get ready for the Halloween One Block challenge! Whenever you mine the One Block you get a random item or block!
Build your way from one spooky island to the next, equip yourself and take on the battle against the Ender Dragon!

Have fun playing!
items.changelog: - Added all new items and block drops up to version 1.21.130 (Mounts of Mayhem)

items.title: Pumpkin Heads
items.creator: Rainbow Theory
items.description:
Trick or Treat! These pumpkin heads are ready to play! Are you ready for a night of haunted terrors?

- 8 Pumpkin Head Skins!
- By Rainbow Theory Studios

items.title: Dragon Shifter
items.creator: Kubo Studios
items.description:
This world allows you to SHAPE SHIFT into 7 different DRAGONS! Be a mighty creature yourself and shoot fire as you fly above the skies! - this is DRAGON SHIFTER!

+ Shape shift into any dragon!
+ Fire, ice, earth, dark, and many more types!
+ Includes arena to fight!

! Only works in the world provided.
